decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The Studio hereby approved shall only be used for purposes incidental to and for the personal enjoyment of the occupiers of the dwellinghouse at 65B Barrowgate Road and shall not be used as a separate residential unit or for business purposes.

Condition : 3 - No development shall take place until samples of the materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the hereby permitted have been submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority.  Development shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details

Condition : 4 - Detailed drawings of the external appearance, including window and door desgn to a scale of not less than 1:20 shall be submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority before development commences and the development shall not be carried out otherwise than in accordance with any such approval given.

Condition : 5 - The windows in the eastern elevation of the studio hereby approved shall be of non-openable obscured glass and no additional window or wndows shall be insterted into this elevation unless prior written approval is obtained from the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 6 - Before the development hereby approved is commenced, the adjoining trees (1 robinia, 1 lime) shall be protected from construction work in accordance with details to be submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority. Only hand excavations shall be carried out beneath the canopy spread of these trees.
description: Erection of single storey detached building for use as a domestic studio in the rear garden of existing dwellinghouse (amended plans received)
